insights.title: Checkout and PIN: Individual trader, Send money drop off far more often than everyone else
insights.summary: The 'Individual trader' persona experiences a high drop-off rate at the 'Checkout and PIN' screen when using 'Send money', accompanied by frequent rage taps and errors. This indicates a technical bug preventing transaction completion for this specific user segment and product.
insights.hypothesis: The 'Individual trader' persona experiences a high drop-off rate at the 'Checkout and PIN' screen when using 'Send money', accompanied by frequent rage taps and errors. This indicates a technical bug preventing transaction completion for this specific user segment and product.
insights.recommendation: Investigate the 'payment_timeout' error specifically for 'Individual trader' users attempting to 'Send money' at the 'Checkout and PIN' screen. Address the underlying technical issue causing the 'payment_timeout' error and rage taps on the 'pay' button.

diagnosis.summary: The 'Individual trader' persona experiences a high drop-off rate at the 'Checkout and PIN' screen when using 'Send money', accompanied by frequent rage taps and errors. This indicates a technical bug preventing transaction completion for this specific user segment and product.
